newsitem.title: GREECE: Ecu/drachma ranges, yield curve idles in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Ecu/drachma ranges, yield curve idles in late trade.

text.p: Ecu/drachma pierced the 305 level after the fixing but met resistance at 305.25 and hovered around 304.90 in late dealings, the interbank swap yield was frozen around morning levels, dealers said.
"The ecu advanced against the drachma on some ecu buying after the fixing but lost ground after meeting strong resistance around 305.20/25," a forex dealer at a foreign bank said.
Interbank depos and forex forwards were little changed in late trade with the central bank holding its overnight bis unchanged at 12.40 percent.
Some banks reported buying interest in floating rate notes from abroad with no sellers in sight but others said activity was subdued.
The mark was quoted at 157.11/21 drachmas from Thursday's 156.970 fix, the dollar at 259.40/50 drachmas from 259.120 and the Ecu at 304.91/01 from 304.950 drachmas.
